title: odontochilus bakhimensis
intro: Odontochilus bakhimensis, commonly known as Himalayan orchid, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. The health benefits of Odontochilus bakhimensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and bronchodilatory properties, making it useful in treating respiratory disorders such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Odontochilus bakhimensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
